Bid Summary.value: The Maryland State Treasurer's Office is soliciting proposals under Secondary Competition PORFP #E20P4600040 (eMMA BPM044557) for 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops, 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4), and 3-year extended hardware warranties. This procurement is a Small Business Reserve (SBR) procurement restricted to authorized Dell Master Contractors under the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007). Proposals must be submitted via eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) by June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM EDT. Delivered equipment must be new, unused, and delivered within 45 days of award.
